report.rationale: The synthetic ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity reported by the remote monitoring center did not result in any adverse patient outcomes, and the issue was handled at a monitoring/investigation level. The retrospective clinician note documenting this event is missing, which may trigger obligations under FDA QMSR 820.120 (Document Control) and EU MDR Article 22 (Post-Market Surveillance). However, since no patient exposure occurred, the issue was contained before any clinical deployment.
